integration.treatment: Existing shared Awa component, responsive images and silhouette glow.

review.pose: Compared with the supplied waving reference: head tilted toward viewer left, viewer-right forepaw raised, three grounded paws, one curled tail, three orange greeting strokes.
review.identity: Compared with the finished Welcome and Collect assets: crescent eyes, four cream fangs, broad orange smile rim, purple cheek flares and collar, orange medallion with purple center.
review.visibleDefects: Inspected full-size artwork and rendered page screenshots for malformed paws or teeth, extra limbs, disconnected shapes, doubled outlines and edge halos. No obvious defects found.
review.format: 1254 x 1254 RGBA PNG master with genuine alpha transparency. Lossless WebP exports at 512 x 512 and 1024 x 1024, resized with the existing cwebp settings. No artistic post-processing.
review.alpha: All four master canvas edges have zero alpha. At a 50 percent alpha threshold, the foreground has exactly four connected components: the character and three greeting strokes.
review.palette: Generated colors visually match the production references; fills retain subtle tonal variation and are not normalized to exact palette RGB values.
review.browser: 14 existing Chromium/WebKit checks passed across desktop, compact iPad, phones, short windows, enlarged text and dark appearance. Inspected desktop, narrow-phone and dark screenshots with the new pose loaded.
review.code: Typecheck passed with zero errors and warnings; targeted formatting, lint and diff checks passed.
review.scope: Visual inspection of generated raster artwork, not a mathematical guarantee of defect-free vector geometry. Native-device verification was not performed.
